bcr.title: Block Custom Rules
bcr.help: Mod options — the top line wins, over every resource pack rule.
bcr.empty: No lines yet — add a block or tag below (e.g. minecraft:cobweb, #minecraft:crops[age=7]).
bcr.cmd.reloaded: Reloaded the mod options (%s rule files, %s block states with rules). Use F3 + T for resource packs.
bcr.cmd.reload_failed: Could not read the config file; keeping the previous rules (see the log).
bcr.problem.json_syntax: JSON syntax error: %s — the whole file is skipped.
bcr.problem.format_unsupported: Unknown format %s (this version reads %s) — the file is skipped.
bcr.problem.unknown_block: No block called %s — this matches nothing.
bcr.problem.unknown_biome: No biome called %s — this matches nothing.
bcr.problem.unknown_entity: No entity type called %s — this matches nothing.
bcr.problem.unknown_tag: No tag or group called %s — this matches nothing.
bcr.problem.combinator_alone: %s must be the only field of its object.
bcr.problem.no_fields: No value fields — this line does nothing.
bcr.problem.group_cycle: Group %s refers back to itself — the loop is read as empty.
bcr.problem.bad_value.cull_pass: cull_pass must be true, false or "default": %s
bcr.problem.bad_value.sway: sway must be a number from 0 to 5 or "default": %s
bcr.problem.bad_value.sound_category: sound_category must be a name like "ns:name" or "default": %s
bcr.problem.bad_value.replace: replace must be true or false: %s
bcr.cmd.tags_not_ready: server tags not loaded yet (title screen)
bcr.cmd.no_target: Look at a block or give one: /bcr rule minecraft:wheat[age=7]
bcr.toast.title: Block Custom Rules
bcr.problem.bad_value.sway_blend_seconds: sway_blend_seconds must be a number from 0 to 5: %s
bcr.problem.bad_value.problem_toast: problem_toast must be true or false: %s
bcr.problem.bad_value.footsteps: footsteps must be true or false: %s
bcr.problem.bad_value.action: An action entry must be {"parent": "action"} or {"parent": null}: %s
bcr.problem.category_cycle: Sound category %s is its own parent through a loop — the loop is cut.
